caseNameFull: American Insurance Co. v. Scheufler, Superintendent
attorneys: Messrs. Wm. Marshall Bullitt, E. R. Morrison, and David A. Murphy for petitioners. Messrs. Charles L. Hensen and Lawrence Presley for respondents.

opinions.text:
*687Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Roberts and Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
